invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。
模型、提示词、技能、bundle、策略和热更新必须先评测再灰度，且始终可回滚。
platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。
Tiger 在获得单独的合规审查和用户明确授权前，只能模拟或纸面交易。
令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

cards.title: Verified product usage restrictions do not reach creative model calls

evidence.note: Host passes only verified raw/hash/query. Generator consumes brief/cards, losing source restrictions. Four actual VideoStudio integration cases first fail.

cards.trigger_path: G1 passed source restrictions -> verifiedRaw without restrictions -> creative/insight/PRD model calls ignore original use limits -> final gate rejects late

assertions.given: Real model adapter interfaces including native vendor prototype bridge, direct and routed transports, concurrent task scopes, complete source restrictions
assertions.expect: Every call receives the full source restrictions; custom system prompt cannot omit them; unrelated/narrative/concurrent runs do not inherit them; malformed limits and overflow stop rather than truncate.

cards.fix_plan: Bind full restriction list hash to raw hash in host-only verified input; validate before vendor construction; AsyncLocalStorage scope appends full limits to all adapter interfaces including vendor-owned engines. Final source qualification remains independent.
cards.blast_radius: Marketing native model input and attested host config; no manual creative decisions, vendor mutation, media retry, source profile changes or added fact authority.
cards.rollback: Revert scoped source restriction propagation; preserve native facts and original archives; do not reuse downstream qualification.
cards.notes: MC008 restriction qualification remains, MC010 ensures generator consumes limits before creative work. Prompt propagation is not proof that every generated claim complies; final system review still required.
